head: pr17396-r9
report:
Replaying the prior probes at this head.

NO DEFECTS

I found no defect to assert at head `08773d3241a`. One of the four prior findings is not fully re-checked: the cancellation probe was still running when the 20-minute budget ran out.

## NOT A DEFECT

**Prior findings, re-checked at this head**

| Prior finding | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| P2: a duration in the error text skipped same-model recovery (`after 401 ns`, `elapsed_ms="401"`) | **Closed** | I re-ran the prior 234-case matrix through `AIError.classify` from the snapshot source: **0 of 234 fail**. The prior round had 87 failures. New readers in `flags.ts`: `UNIT_NUMBER_PATTERN`, `DURATION_FIELD_KEY`, `withoutMetadataNumbers`. |
| P2: reusing a built transport overcounted unrelated calls | **Closed** | Same native Anthropic server, two different prompts that each get cut mid-stream. In all four modes (reused options on `streamAnthropic`, `stream`, `streamSimple`, and a shared `transportFetch(model, undefined)`) there were 2 requests and replay counts `[0,0]`. The prior round saw `[0,1]` for the shared transport. `withRequestTransport` now starts a new counter per call. |
| P2: a longer repeated retry hint was ignored | **Closed** | `extractProviderRetryHint` returns **9000** for `retry-after-ms=200 retry-after-ms=9000`, for the reverse order, and for `try again in 200ms; try again in 9000ms`. It now uses `longestRetryHint`. |
| P2: cancellation could be lost (`abortRetry()` at `auto_retry_start`, and after a credential rotation) | **Closed in code; runtime replay incomplete** | The patch checks a cancel flag (`#isRetryCancelled`) after the reset read, after the rotation, after recording the attempt, after `auto_retry_start`, after the sleep, in the scheduled continuation's `shouldContinue`/`onSkip`, and at the start of the next failure's handling. See below for the partial replay. |

**Partial replay of the cancellation probe.** I re-ran the prior `recovery-moments.test.ts` (prior probes need a `node_modules` symlink to the snapshot and must be run from the scratch directory). Three cases finished: `held-request`, `provider-wait` and `fallback-event`. Each "failed" only because that file asserts the saga carries on to the next fallback model after the cancel (`counts.get(models[2].id) === 1`). At this head the third model is never requested (`undefined`), which means the cancel is now honoured. The cases that measure the reported 14-extra-request bug (`retry-start`, `retry-sleep`) and `rotation-cancel.test.ts` had not finished.

**Suspicions ruled out**
- **`onSkip` added to `TurnRecoveryHost.scheduleAgentContinue`:** the consumer side forwards it. `agent-session.ts:5389/5420` call `#skipAgentContinue("should-continue-false", request)`, which calls `request.options.onSkip?.(reason)` (line 5268). The cancelled-saga close is not silently dropped.
- **Cancel flag left set after the retried request succeeds:** it is cleared. Success ends in `#closeRetrySaga`, then `resolveRetry()`, which clears `#retryCancelledGeneration`. So a later failure in the same prompt is not wrongly treated as cancelled.
- **Direct `streamAnthropic` calls losing `coworkFetch`:** no change. Before the patch, direct calls already fell back to the global `fetch` in `buildAnthropicClientOptions` (`args.fetch ?? fetch`); `coworkFetch` is only picked up in `transportFetch` on the `stream()` path, which still gets it.
- **Scratch environment failures:** the first probe runs auto-installed published packages into the scratch directory, and `TempDir.createSync` hit EACCES when the working directory was the read-only snapshot. Both were setup problems, not results.
